description: This file defines the SearchTextProcessorInterface interface within the Drupal search module, including constants for Unicode character classes and method signatures for processing and analyzing search text.

classes.name: SearchTextProcessorInterface
classes.description: Interface for processing search text, including constants for Unicode character classes and methods for processing and analyzing text.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes text into words for indexing, considering language code if provided.

methods.name: analyze
methods.description: Runs the text through character analyzers for indexing, including decoding, lowercasing, diacritics removal, CJK processing, punctuation handling, and truncation.
